entities.name: Mutawakkilite Kingdom
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Mutawakkilite Kingdom, a political institution in Yemen during Divided Yemen (1918–1962). Grew from Aden becomes one of the world's busiest ports after the Suez Canal opens and British Aden and Second Ottoman Period. Led to the emergence of Imam Yahya assassinated in a failed coup attempt.
